test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, E, O, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only one person sits between A and S. Only two people sit between S and E. R sits second to the left of E. T sits second to the left of A. Who is sitting to the immediate left of O?
solution: Given: A, E, O, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) R sits second to the left of E. 2) Only two people sit between S and E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13e49e1aa678d3120bd2180f8def90abfab866e2ef60c3969c9f60b5aad63335.png]
